lessons.title: Sana va bayram: on 5 May
lessons.goal: Sana aytishni va qachon ekanini so'rashni o'rganasiz. Hafta kunlari, oylar va bayramlar lug'ati.

frame.name: Sanalar: on + kun + oy
frame.formula:
When is your birthday?   — It's on 5 May.
My birthday is in May.
The meeting is on Monday at 10.
We don't work at the weekend.
frame.explain: Sana aytilganda on + kun + oy ishlatiladi: on 5 May (o'qilishi: on the fifth of May). Faqat oy bo'lsa — in: in May. Hafta kuni — on: on Monday. Dam olish kunlari — at the weekend.

short: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.

examples.en: When is your birthday? — My birthday is on 12 April.
examples.uz: Tug'ilgan kuningiz qachon? — 12-aprelda.

examples.en: The shop is closed on Sunday, and it opens again on Monday morning.
examples.uz: Do'kon yakshanba kuni yopiq, dushanba ertalab yana ochiladi.

examples.en: We have a holiday in January, and another one in March.
examples.uz: Yanvarda bir bayramimiz bor, martda yana bittasi.

examples.en: Christmas is in December, and Easter is usually in April.
examples.uz: Rojdestvo dekabrda, Pasxa odatda aprelda.

examples.en: My parents got married in June, and their wedding was on a Friday.
examples.uz: Ota-onam iyunda turmush qurishgan, to'ylari juma kuni edi.

examples.en: At the weekend I don't work — I rest on Saturday and Sunday.
examples.uz: Dam olish kunlari ishlamayman — shanba va yakshanba dam olaman.

examples.en: Is the meeting on Wednesday or on Thursday?
examples.uz: Uchrashuv chorshanbadami yoki payshanbadami?

examples.en: February is short, but September and October are busy months for us.
examples.uz: Fevral qisqa, lekin sentabr va oktabr biz uchun band oylar.

street.title: Uchrashuv belgilash
street.note: "How about ...?" — taklif kiritishning eng qisqa usuli; undan keyin ot yoki -ing shakl keladi.

lines.en: When is your birthday?
It's on 3 March. And yours?
Mine is in July — on 21 July.
That's in summer, great! Do you have a holiday then?
lines.uz: Bu yozda, zo'r! O'shanda ta'tilingiz bormi?

lines.en: Yes, I usually take a week off.
lines.uz: Ha, odatda bir hafta ta'til olaman.

lines.en: Let's celebrate together this year.

translate.en: I don't work at the weekend.

lessons.tip: Oy va hafta kunlari ingliz tilida doim katta harf bilan yoziladi: Monday, January. Sanada kun birinchi keladi: 5 May, amerikacha variantda — May 5.

lessons.title: Hozir bo'layotgan ish: I am doing
lessons.goal: Present Continuous zamonini o'zlashtirasiz va ob-havo haqida gapirishni o'rganasiz.

frame.name: Present Continuous: am / is / are + V-ing
frame.formula:
It is raining now.
The sun is shining.
I am wearing a coat.
Is it snowing outside?   — Yes, it is.
frame.explain: Hozir, shu daqiqada bo'layotgan ish: am / is / are + fe'l + ing. Ob-havo haqida gapirganda ega sifatida it ishlatiladi: It is raining, it is cold. Doimiy holat uchun esa Present Simple qoladi.

aff: The children are playing in the snow.
neg: The children aren't playing in the snow.
short: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

examples.en: It is raining, so take an umbrella.
examples.uz: Yomg'ir yog'ayapti, shuning uchun soyabon oling.

examples.en: In summer the sun is shining and the sky is blue.
examples.uz: Yozda quyosh charaqlab turadi va osmon ko'k bo'ladi.

examples.en: It isn't snowing today, but it is very cold.
examples.uz: Bugun qor yog'mayapti, lekin juda sovuq.

examples.en: The wind is blowing, and there are a lot of clouds in the sky.
examples.uz: Shamol esyapti, osmonda ko'p bulut bor.

examples.en: Is it foggy in the morning in autumn?
examples.uz: Kuzda ertalab tuman bo'ladimi?

examples.en: The temperature is twenty degrees, and the air is warm.
examples.uz: Harorat yigirma daraja, havo iliq.

examples.en: In winter it is cold and it often snows.
examples.uz: Qishda sovuq bo'ladi va tez-tez qor yog'adi.

examples.en: Why are you wearing a coat? It's hot outside!
examples.uz: Nega palto kiygansiz? Tashqarida issiq-ku!

street.title: Ob-havo haqida
street.note: "What's the weather like?" — "ob-havo qanday?" degan savol; so'zma-so'z "ob-havo nimaga o'xshaydi".

lines.en: What's the weather like in winter here?
It's cold and it often snows. The temperature is about minus ten.
lines.uz: Sovuq va tez-tez qor yog'adi. Harorat taxminan minus o'n.

lines.en: Is it raining now?
No, but it's cloudy and windy.
What about summer?
In summer it's hot and sunny, about thirty-five degrees.
lines.uz: Yozda issiq va quyoshli, taxminan o'ttiz besh daraja.

translate.en: Why are you wearing a coat?

lessons.tip: Present Continuous — hozir, shu daqiqada. Doimiy holat uchun Present Simple: It rains a lot in April (aprelda ko'p yomg'ir yog'adi) / It is raining now (hozir yog'yapti).

lessons.title: Ko'ra olaman: can see, can hear
lessons.goal: "Qila olaman" strukturasini can / can't bilan o'zlashtirasiz va tabiat so'zlarini o'rganasiz.

frame.name: can / can't + fe'l
frame.formula:
I can see the sea from my window.
I can't hear you.
Can you see that mountain?   — Yes, I can.
frame.explain: can — qobiliyat yoki imkoniyat. Undan keyin fe'l har doim o'zak shaklda keladi: can see, can swim, can't hear. Inkor — can't (cannot), savol — Can you ...?
table: Yes, I can. / No, I can't.

short: Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
Yes, she can. / No, she can't.

examples.en: I can see the sea and a small island from my window.
examples.uz: Derazamdan dengiz va kichik orolni ko'raman.

examples.en: Can you see that mountain behind the forest?
examples.uz: O'rmon orqasidagi anavi tog'ni ko'ryapsizmi?

examples.en: We can't hear you — the wind is very strong.
examples.uz: Sizni eshitmayapmiz — shamol juda kuchli.

examples.en: There is a lake near the village, and a river between the hills.
examples.uz: Qishloq yaqinida ko'l, tepaliklar orasida daryo bor.

examples.en: In the desert there is a lot of sand and very little water.
examples.uz: Cho'lda ko'p qum va juda kam suv bor.

examples.en: My grandfather has a farm in the field near the forest.
examples.uz: Buamning o'rmon yaqinidagi dalada fermasi bor.

examples.en: Can you smell the flowers in the garden?
examples.uz: Bog'dagi gullarning hidini sezyapsizmi?

examples.en: The earth is our home, and nature needs our help.
examples.uz: Yer bizning uyimiz, tabiat esa bizning yordamimizga muhtoj.

street.title: Tabiatda
street.note: "Let's go for a walk" — sayrga chiqishni taklif qilishning tabiiy shakli; "go to walk" emas.

lines.en: Can you see the lake from here?
Yes, I can. And there's a small island in the middle.
lines.uz: Ha. Va o'rtasida kichik orol bor.

lines.en: Is that a forest behind the hills?
It is. My grandfather has a farm near it.
lines.uz: Ha. Buamning u yer yaqinida fermasi bor.

lines.en: Can you hear the river?
No, I can't — but I can smell the flowers.

substitution.prompt: There is a lot of ___ in the desert. (qum)
substitution.answer: There is a lot of sand in the desert.

translate.en: There is a lake near the forest.

fix.wrong: I can to see the sea.

fix.why: can't dan keyin fe'l o'zak shaklda

lessons.tip: can dan keyin fe'l har doim o'zak shaklda: can swim, can see, can't hear. to ham, -s ham qo'shilmaydi. Bir xil qoida must, should, will uchun ham amal qiladi.

lessons.title: Ranglar va sifat tartibi
lessons.goal: Ranglarni o'zlashtirasiz va bir nechta sifat birga kelganda ularning tartibini o'rganasiz.

frame.name: Sifat + ot tartibi
frame.formula:
a big black car            o'lcham → rang
a small round table        o'lcham → shakl
two long red curtains      o'lcham → rang
an old white house         yosh → rang
frame.explain: Sifatlar ot oldidan keladi. Bir nechta sifat bo'lsa, tartib bor: fikr → o'lcham → yosh → rang → material. Shuning uchun a big black car to'g'ri, "a black big car" esa noto'g'ri.
table: a nice big old white house

aff: This is a big black car.
neg: This isn't a big black car.
q: Is this a big black car?
short: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

examples.en: My father has a big black car and a small white bicycle.
examples.uz: Dadamning katta qora mashinasi va kichik oq velosipedi bor.

examples.en: The walls in the living room are light grey, and the curtains are long and red.
examples.uz: Mehmonxonadagi devorlar och kulrang, pardalar esa uzun va qizil.

examples.en: She is wearing a short pink dress and white shoes.
examples.uz: U kalta pushti ko'ylak va oq tufli kiygan.

examples.en: There is a round wooden table in the kitchen and two brown chairs.
examples.uz: Oshxonada dumaloq yog'och stol va ikki jigarrang stul bor.

examples.en: The sky is deep blue in summer, and the leaves are bright green in spring.
examples.uz: Yozda osmon to'q ko'k, bahorda barglar yorqin yashil bo'ladi.

examples.en: This box is too heavy, and that bag is too thin.
examples.uz: Bu quti juda og'ir, anavi sumka esa juda yupqa.

examples.en: Is your new phone black or purple?
examples.uz: Yangi telefoningiz qorami yoki binafshami?

examples.en: We need a wide road and a narrow bridge for this village.
examples.uz: Bu qishloq uchun keng yo'l va tor ko'prik kerak.

street.title: Rang va ko'rinish

items.en: I like that dark green one.

street.note: Rangga ohang qo'shish: light blue (och ko'k), dark blue (to'q ko'k), bright red (yorqin qizil), pale pink (och pushti).

lines.en: I want a new sofa for the living room.
What colour?
Something dark — brown or grey.
We have a big brown sofa and a small grey one.
lines.uz: Katta jigarrang divan va kichik kulrang divanimiz bor.

lines.en: The brown one looks nice. How much is it?
It's cheaper than the grey one.

translate.en: This is a big black car.

lessons.tip: Rang sifat bo'lib ot oldidan keladi: a red apple. O'zbekchada "qizil olma" — tartib bir xil, lekin ingliz tilida a / the artiklini unutmang: a red apple, the red apple.

lessons.title: Xarakter va holat: She is kind, he looks tired
lessons.goal: Odamning xarakteri va holatini ta'riflashni o'rganasiz: be + sifat, look / seem / feel + sifat.

frame.name: be / look / feel + sifat
frame.formula:
She is very kind.
He looks tired today.
They seem happy.
Are you busy now?   — Yes, I am.
frame.explain: Sifat to be fe'lidan keyin keladi: She is kind. "Ko'rinmoq" ma'nosida look, "his qilmoq" uchun feel, "tuyulmoq" uchun seem ishlatiladi — ular ham sifat bilan keladi.

short: Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.

examples.en: My neighbor is a very kind and polite woman.
examples.uz: Qo'shnim juda mehribon va odobli ayol.

examples.en: He looks tired today because he is very busy.
examples.uz: Bugun u charchagan ko'rinadi, chunki juda band.

examples.en: Are you free this evening? — I'm sorry, I'm busy.
examples.uz: Bugun kechqurun bo'shmisiz? — Kechirasiz, bandman.

examples.en: Don't be rude to the waiter — he is doing his job.
examples.uz: Ofitsiantga qo'pol munosabatda bo'lmang — u o'z ishini qilyapti.

examples.en: Their new house is big and beautiful, but it looks empty.
examples.uz: Ularning yangi uyi katta va chiroyli, lekin bo'sh ko'rinadi.

examples.en: My grandfather is old but very strong, and he is never lazy.
examples.uz: Buam qari, lekin juda kuchli va hech qachon dangasa emas.

examples.en: Why is she sad? — Her old friend is moving to another country.
examples.uz: Nega u g'amgin? — Eski do'sti boshqa mamlakatga ko'chib ketyapti.

examples.en: Poor people are often more generous than rich people.
examples.uz: Kambag'al odamlar ko'pincha boylardan saxiyroq bo'ladi.

street.title: Odam haqida

items.en: She's in a good mood today.

street.note: "It's not a big deal" — "bu muhim narsa emas", tasalli berish uchun ishlatiladi.

lines.en: You look tired. Are you OK?
I'm fine, just busy. I have a lot of work.
Is your new job hard?
It's difficult, but the people are kind and polite.
lines.uz: Qiyin, lekin odamlar mehribon va odobli.

lines.en: That's good. Don't work too much!
I know. I'm free on Sunday, so I can rest.

lessons.tip: Sifat bilan "bo'lmoq" — to be: I am tired, she is happy. "I have tired" xato, chunki have faqat ega bo'lishni bildiradi: I have a car.
